a11y.apg: No APG pattern and no keyboard: it is an <ol>, because the order IS the information and a screen reader announces the count and position for free.

props.name: items
props.type: Array<{title: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; time?: ReactNode}>
props.description: The events, rendered as an <ol> because the order IS the information. `time` is a node, so an absolute date and a relative one are equally welcome.

props.name: variant
props.description: The style (ADR-0084), all on the fixed rail that runs under the dots and stops at the last one: default (the solid yellow dot), ring (a hollow dot with a yellow ring), latest (muted dots, only the last one yellow with a halo), time (the time in a column on the left, right-aligned; the rail moves with the dot) or contrast (dots in the text colour). Written as data-timeline-style. Web and React Native; on React Native an item with an icon keeps its frame in every style.
